items.description: Utah announced a first-of-its kind pilot program allowing an autonomous artificial intelligence (AI) agent to renew prescriptions for consumers who request it . The state agreed not to enforce its unprofessional conduct laws against the developer, Doctronic . The pilot program includes 192 drugs for chronic conditions .
